|url=https://www.doncaster.gov.uk/services/the-council-democracy/upcoming-elections |publisher=Doncaster Council |accessdate=26 May 2020}} All 55 councillors were elected from 21 wards which return either two or three councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.
